s001: The tooth character speaks to the camera with a sad, heavy expression, mouth moving as if talking, eyes blinking slowly while his small arms shift on the gum. The gum pulses gently. Static camera.
s002: The woman slowly strokes the cat's head with soft repeated movements and smiles, while the cat eats calmly from the bowl, its head dipping gently. Both stay in place. Static camera.
s003: The tooth character talks worriedly to the camera, mouth moving as if speaking, eyebrows lifting, his arms pressing lightly on the swollen gum, which throbs slowly. The yellow plaque stays in place. Slow camera push-in.
s004: The tooth character speaks miserably, mouth moving slightly as if talking, eyes downcast, while the two bacteria keep working at his side, one drilling with small vibrations, the other tapping its pickaxe. Static camera.
s005: The woman gently scratches under the cat's chin and the cat leans into her hand with eyes closed, purring contentedly. Small soft movements; both stay seated on the sofa. Static camera.
s006: The cat slowly chews the kibble, head dipping into the bowl and jaw working carefully, ears twitching slightly. The cat stays crouched over the bowl. Static camera.
s007: The cat winces, eyes squeezing tighter and head pulling back slightly, as the small red glowing spot on its jaw pulses. The cat stays seated in place. Slow camera push-in.
s008: The cat meows up at the woman with its mouth open, and she leans back slightly, wrinkling her nose and waving her hand in front of her face. Both stay seated on the sofa. Static camera.
s009: The cat sniffs toward the bowl, then slowly turns its head away with a reluctant, pained grimace, ears flattening a little. The cat stays in place beside the bowl. Static camera.
s010: The cat chews slowly on one side of its mouth, head tilted, wincing with one eye shut, jaw moving carefully. The cat stays crouched over the bowl. Static camera.
s011: The tooth character speaks with a grim, knowing look, mouth moving as if talking, arms folded, giving a slow small nod and a sideways glance. The gum stays still. Static camera.
s012: The tooth character winces and talks through gritted teeth, mouth moving, while the bacterium beside him drills into his base with small vibrations and the dark stain creeps slowly upward. Slow camera push-in.
s013: The two bacteria peer down into the dark hole, grinning and rocking gently with their drills, while the ragged edges of the hole pulse slowly and the vessel below glistens. They stay on the rim. Slow camera push-in.
s014: The two bacteria float slowly through the blood-vessel tunnel, bobbing gently and grinning, as red blood cells drift past around them. They stay in the centre of the frame. Slow camera push-in.
s015: The two bacteria ride the red blood cell like a raft, swaying gently as it glides slowly down the tunnel, one pointing ahead. Blood cells drift past and the light ahead glows. Slow camera push-in.
s016: The kidney character winces and groans, eyes drooping, while the two bacteria chip at it, one drilling with small vibrations, the other swinging its pickaxe in short strokes. Sweat drops slide slowly. Static camera.
s017: The woman stares at the long bill in disbelief, her raised hand trembling slightly as the paper sways gently, while the cat in the carrier blinks slowly. She stays standing at the desk. Static camera.
s018: The cat sleeps under anaesthetic, its side rising and falling with slow breaths, while the heart line on the monitor scrolls steadily and the red light flickers faintly. The number on the monitor stays unchanged. Static camera.
s019: The tooth character speaks earnestly to the camera, mouth moving as if talking, eyebrows raised, leaning forward slightly with his hands pressing lightly on the gum. Slow camera push-in.
s020: The woman laughs happily, shoulders shaking gently, while the cat sits calmly in her lap, blinking slowly and glancing around. Both stay seated on the sofa. Static camera.
s021: The cat looks down at the full bowl miserably, lowers its head slightly, then pulls back a little without eating, ears drooping. The cat stays crouched in place. Slow camera push-in.
s022: The cat sits calmly on the window sill with a composed face, blinking slowly once, its tail tip twitching while the plants sway faintly in the breeze. The cat stays seated. Slow camera push-in.
s023: The tooth character speaks firmly to the camera, mouth moving as if talking, raising his pointing finger with a determined nod. The gum around him stays still. Static camera.
s024: The tooth character looks up hopefully and speaks, mouth moving as if talking, as streams of glowing golden saliva flow slowly down around him and tiny sparkles drift. Slow camera push-in.
s025: The tooth character speaks happily, mouth moving as if talking, as golden saliva swirls; the zinc nugget glows brightly while the green bacterium shrinks slowly and dissolves into glowing particles. Static camera.
s026: The tooth character speaks with a relieved smile, mouth moving as if talking, as the two enzyme sprites chip at the yellow plaque on his base, which crumbles slowly into drifting golden flakes. Static camera.
s027: The tooth character smiles and speaks, mouth moving as if talking, as the lilac probiotic crowd presses gently forward and the yellow bacterium shrinks back and fades into glowing particles. Golden saliva swirls. Static camera.
s028: The powder character speaks cheerfully to the camera, mouth moving as if talking, with a small wave of one hand, while the scoop stays steady in the hand. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
s029: The zinc nugget and the two enzyme sprites stand on the worktop, waving and swaying gently in place with big grins beside the still toothpaste tube. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
s030: The zinc nugget, the probiotic and the enzyme sprites peek out of the open tub, waving and swaying gently in place as fine powder sparkles drift. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Slow camera push-in.
s031: The woman slowly tips the scoop, sprinkling a fine stream of powder onto the food in the bowl, smiling softly. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
s032: The powder character talks to the camera with a cheeky raised eyebrow, mouth moving as if speaking, hands on hips with a small shrug, while the scoop stays steady. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
s033: The tooth character smiles broadly, mouth not talking, and sways gently with relief as golden sparkles drift around him and the healthy pink gum glistens softly. Slow camera push-in.
s034: The vet gently strokes the cat on the table while the woman watches worriedly, slowly tightening her grip on her open bag. The cat blinks and stays seated on the towel. Static camera.
s035: The empty operating theatre stays quiet and still; faint dust motes drift slowly through the window light and the switched-off lamp hangs motionless. Slow camera push-in.
s036: The cat happily laps at the dusted wet food, head dipping gently and tongue moving, eyes half closed with contentment. The cat stays at the bowl. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
s037: The powder character sits smugly with arms folded and eyes closed, speaking with a proud lift of the chin, mouth moving as if talking, while the scoop stays steady. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
s038: The cat sniffs the food closely with half-closed contented eyes, whiskers twitching and nose moving gently, then takes a small slow bite. The cat stays at the bowl. Slow camera push-in.
s039: The shield badge hovers gently and glints with a soft shine, its text unchanged, while the liquid in the test tubes shimmers faintly. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Slow camera push-in.
s040: The vet smiles warmly and gives a small nod while holding the tub steady, and the cat blinks slowly, looking up at her. The badge stays still. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
s041: The ribbon badge glints softly, its text unchanged, as sparkles drift upward and the golden liquid beneath the tubs ripples gently. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Slow camera push-in.
s042: The cat smiles cheekily at the camera, paw resting on the tub lid, tilting its head and giving a slow wink. The button stays still. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
